name: paper-plane-route-draw
title: Paper Plane Route Draw
description: A paper plane swells from small to large as it flies along a looping curved route with its nose following the line, while the route draws in behind it and then thins out, and the whole scene fades away.
useWhen: A trip, delivery or journey intro needs a simple icon flying along a drawn route.
A short logo-less opener that suggests travel or shipping.
avoidWhen: The route must be tied to a real map with pins: use flight-route-map.
A headline should ride along the line: use path-ride.
author: GreenSock
